label: canvasSampleWakesRows: a canvas drag sample also sets the scrub-only copy, so the inspector style rows rerun per sample
find: edit.sample(from: start, to: end, modifiers: modifiers)
replace:
edit.sample(from: start, to: end, modifiers: modifiers)
        scrubbed = edit.workspace

label: opacityRowFollowsCanvas: the Opacity row reads the canvas drag's copy again
find:
let shown = live?.scrubbed ?? model
        let opacity = shown.sharedValue { shown.shown($0).opacity }
replace:
let shown = live?.workspace ?? model
        let opacity = shown.sharedValue { shown.shown($0).opacity }

label: fillRowFollowsCanvas: the Fill section reads the canvas drag's copy again
